text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While training with Silence Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There you are, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, Air Groove. Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, the student council is conducting
an
orientation for our newest students...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And they wouldn't stop asking if they
could meet
you just once.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Behind Air Groove, a number of younger
students
are staring at Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Young Student A
text_block_list.text: Omigosh! It's really Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Young Student B
text_block_list.text:
She's that "runaway superstar," right?
She's so
coooool!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh? Th-they all know me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Of course they do. You've garnered
quite a few
followers among the younger
students as of late.

text_block_list.name: Young Student A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Suzuka! Um, would it be all right if
we ran
together?

text_block_list.name: Young Student B
text_block_list.text:
Hey! No fair! I want Suzuka to teach me
her
running style too!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now, hold on a second. Can't you see
Suzuka's in
the middle of her training?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...
choice_data_list: 少しだけならいいんじゃないか
少しだけならいいんじゃないかな

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to Silence Suzuka how
instructing the
younger students can also
benefit her.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
All right... I'm not sure I'm quite up to
the task
though...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But... Uh, Trainer? How should I even
begin?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Run with them... Okay! Running is my specialty.
choice_data_list: 併走トレーニングから

text_block_list.name: Young Student A
text_block_list.text: Really?! Yippeee! I'm so excited!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Suzuka. I'll say this as a precaution.
Don't go
overboard.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I really mean it. Do you understand me?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
We'll be all right. We're only running
after all.
There's nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You "only running" is precisely what I'm
worried
about.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, I'll leave them in your
hands for
now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Okay, everyone. Ready... go!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Pheeew!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes? Do you want to run too?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh.. No. I want to know why you're running laps all by yourself when you should be running with the students I left you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I explicitly tell you not to go
overboard?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Young Student A
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! I'm super happy I got to see
Suzuka run
up close!

text_block_list.name: Young Student B
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We wanna do our best to
keep up! So
please, keep going!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh... Um...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What should I do, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, if they say it's all right, then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch over Silence Suzuka as she
instructs the
eager young students.

text_block_list.name: Young Student B
text_block_list.text: Wow! Can you believe it? Suzuka's teaching us?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I don't know if I'd call it a lesson per se...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just take it step by step, Suzuka. For
example,
what goes through your mind
right before the
start of a race?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... I just think about enjoying
running.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...All right. And after that?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Then I run. And then I run more.
And I
keep running until I reach the
finish line.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see... In hindsight, I shouldn't have
bothered
asking you to explain.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-why?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! Once she's taken the lead, she
uses her
position to control the pace,
and—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wow... That sounds so complicated.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This is your strategy!

text_block_list.name: Young Student B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! We'll put what
we've learned
to use the next chance we
get!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That was so easy to understand. You're
amazing,
Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please. You've certainly heard as much
in your
racing tactics class.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And regardless of whether you adopt it
or not, it
wouldn't hurt to commit the
theorem to memory.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because you never know when you'll be
in a
position in which you must teach
someone else.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're right... So, um, Air Groove.
Would you be
all right with teaching me
again sometime?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh? Are you ready for that?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, then. Seeing as your grades could use the help, I suppose we'll have to organize an intensive study session soon.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, Trainer...
choice_data_list: よろしくお願いします

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, it seems as though
Silence
Suzuka's grades have gone up
thanks to Air
Groove's instruction.
